ios.desc:
Turn your camera into a nutrition coach.
MyFoodyAI lets you photo-scan any meal and instantly see calories, macros and an AI-powered 1-to-10 health score — no typing required.

What you can do
• Snap & analyse – point the camera or pick a photo; our model extracts ingredients, calories, carbs, protein and fat and rates meal quality on the spot.
• Track water – log glasses in two taps and follow your daily hydration goal.
• See progress at a glance – calories, macro split and health score are saved to your private calendar.
• Sync with HealthKit – height, weight and age auto-fill to fine-tune recommendations.
• Stay private… or go social – keep data for your eyes only or switch the profile to public and inspire friends; you can even search other users by username.
• Clean onboarding – Sign in with Apple, Google or email, grant camera/photos once and you’re set.

Whether you want to lose weight, gain muscle or simply understand what’s on your plate, Food AI gives you actionable insights in seconds.

Why users love Food AI
– No manual search or database picking
– Works with homemade meals and restaurant plates
– Fully free to start
– Simple and fluid interface

Download now and make every bite count.
